northshire_abbey.name: Northshire Abbey
northshire_abbey.description: A beacon of hope in the tranquil Northshire Valley, the Abbey is where new adventurers begin their journey. The air is calm, and monks can be seen practicing their martial arts.

elwynn_forest_road.name: Road in Elwynn Forest
elwynn_forest_road.description: A dusty road winding through the lush Elwynn Forest. To the north, you see Northshire Abbey.
